summary: Iteration 3 frontend validated end-to-end on top of main agent's curl-verified backend. Confirmed: (1) Settings company-invoice-prefix saved as 'FAC' and preview 'FAC-2026-0001' displays; value persists after reload. (2) Facturas 'Nueva factura' preloads series 'FAC' (from company prefix), preview 'FAC-2026-XXXX' shown, and creating an invoice results in row data-testid invoice-row-FAC-2026-0002 (sequence per prefix+year). Summary total live-computed 605,00 € (500 base + 21% IVA). (3) invoice-edit-FAC-2026-0002 opens dialog titled 'Editar factura' with fields preloaded; invoice-series input is NOT rendered in edit mode (count=0); changing price to 800 recalculates total to 968,00 € live; saving keeps same number (row still present) — PUT flow OK. (4) Expenses: created a manual gasto then expense-edit-0 opens 'Editar gasto' with base preloaded 100; changed to 250 and saved (PUT). (5) Impuestos: export-xlsx and export-csv buttons visible; xlsx button opens popup targeted at /api/export/libros?format=xlsx (window.open, uses same-site cookies). Backend export endpoints already verified by main agent (xlsx 7355 bytes PK header, CSV with BOM). Regression: invoice-pdf-{n} and invoice-email-{n} buttons still wired (untested this round; iter 2 covered).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description — a11y warning in console (non-blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: Invoices.js: on openNew the series defaults to the fetched company prefix — good. Consider disabling the series field visually to indicate the format, but not blocking.
Expenses.js: base_amount fallback uses (exp.base ?? exp.base_amount ?? '') — correct given backend returns 'base'.
Taxes.js: exportLibros uses window.open with cookies (same-site); works as expected. If any user has strict tracking prevention, popup may be blocked — acceptable for MVP.
server.py is approaching ~500+ lines with new PUT/export endpoints; consider extracting export routes to routers/export.py in a future refactor.
InvoiceInput.series is optional; recomputing base/IVA/IRPF/total on PUT correctly preserves number and series (verified via UI same-row check).
